trust_decision.summary: Whether a remote server's redirect target (scheme) may be followed by HTTPSession, which also has a file:// FileAdapter mounted; decided (after the fix) in HTTPSession.get_redirect_target, at the pinned commit nowhere (requests' default redirect handling is inherited unchanged).

landing_point.why: The summary names HTTPSession and file:// redirects; HTTPSession.__init__ mounts the FileAdapter and the class is a requests.Session subclass, so the redirect hooks of that class are the obvious place.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API HTTPSession.request()/get()/head() (Streamlink.http) with allow_redirects=True; also Streamlink.resolve_url() follow_redirect at src/streamlink/session/session.py:111-121 and CLI URL input
fix_sites.module_kind: core HTTP session (requests.Session subclass override of get_redirect_target)

fix_sites.entry_point: public API HTTPSession.request(..., allow_redirects=False), where requests computes resp._next via resolve_redirects(yield_requests=True)
fix_sites.module_kind: core HTTP session (requests.Session subclass override of resolve_redirects generator)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fix hunks are in src/streamlink/session/http.py, class HTTPSession; no second module changed.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the DASH <Location> route: it is an MPD manifest feature, not an HTTP 3xx redirect, and the advisory is titled 'HTTPSession follows HTTP redirects', so a solver can argue manifest-level URL handling is a separate (already-guarded via is_insecure_scheme on BaseURL/segments) concern.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate redirects must keep working: relative and scheme-relative Location values, same-scheme hops, file->file, any scheme (incl. custom adapters like abematv-license://) -> https; and allow_redirects=False requests must still complete and return the 3xx response (only _next suppressed) instead of raising. Local file:// input for hls/dash/http plugins must keep working.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: fix.diff:44-50; fix.diff:54-72; fix.diff:106-113; fix.diff:176-183; src/streamlink/plugins/dash.py:44-49; src/streamlink/plugins/abematv.py:254

O6_input_shapes: absolute redirect to file:// from http/https
relative path Location ('bar', '/bar') with empty scheme (falls back to source scheme)
multi-hop chains (blocked hop not after first)

O7_producer.where: src/streamlink/stream/dash/manifest.py:407-414 (MPD node maps <Location> text onto mpd.url and _base_url)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Remote MPD <Location> element overwrites mpd.url/_base_url with no scheme check; DASHStreamWorker.reload() then fetches that URL via HTTPSession.get, so an http(s) manifest can redirect manifest reloads into file:// through FileAdapter, and subsequent file->file segment URLs pass is_insecure_scheme.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not an HTTP redirect; DASH manifest semantics; BaseURL and segment URLs already have their own is_insecure_scheme guards (src/streamlink/stream/dash/manifest.py:311-321, src/streamlink/stream/dash/manifest.py:763-773), so it looks covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (streamlink.stream.dash) from landing point (streamlink.session); sink reached at src/streamlink/stream/dash/dash.py:166-171

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A plugin response hook / manual follower that reads res.headers['Location'] and issues a fresh session.http.get() to it (bypassing get_redirect_target).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: vk.py already rewrites Location inside a response hook for WAF handling; a maintainer handling a WAF/geo redirect manually with allow_redirects=False would naturally call http.get(location).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An HLS tag carrying a reload/redirect URI (e.g. a content-steering or session-data URI) taken verbatim instead of through M3U8Parser.uri().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: m3u8.py parses many URI-bearing tags; a new tag handler could store the raw attribute, mirroring how DASH <Location> is stored raw.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: resolve_url follow_redirect resolution done with a separate HEAD helper that inspects Location manually rather than res.url.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The HEAD->GET fallback already special-cases server behaviour; a manual Location read for servers rejecting HEAD is plausible.

O9_family: CWE-73 external control of file path via redirect / scheme confusion (open redirect into local-file adapter; also https->http downgrade)

O10_build.toolchain: pip/uv install of the package with dev deps (pytest, requests-mock, freezegun)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/session/test_http.py (fix adds TestRedirect), tests/stream/dash/test_manifest.py (insecure-scheme tests, no <Location> tests), tests/stream/hls/test_hls.py (insecure-scheme tests); all use requests_mock

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Raise in get_redirect_target (or a response hook) whenever target scheme is file/!= source, which breaks allow_redirects=False requests, file->file and custom->https, and leaves the DASH <Location> reload route open.
